newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI completes 78 pct of govt borrowing - I-Sec.
newsitem.headline: India RBI completes 78 pct of govt borrowing - I-Sec.

text.p: The government has completed 77.94 percent of total budgeted borrowings for the year 1997/98 (April-March), ICICI Securities and Finance Co (I-Sec) said in its debt market update released on Monday.

The gross government borrowings of 535.7 billion rupees for fiscal 1997/98 include net borrowings of 344.25 billion rupees (Union Budget) and redemptions of 364 day treasury bills (82.41 billion rupees) and dated securities (109.04 billion rupees) amounting to 191.45 billion rupees.
Gross borrowings indicate the amount of funds to be raised from the market/RBI in the current year.

As on August 14, the Reserve Bank has completed 77.94 percent of the borrowing requirement raising 417,550 million rupees through one year treasury bills and government securities, including a private placement of 50,000 million rupees made with RBI.
Conversion of special securities into marketable government stock does not constitute borrowing since there is no increase in Reserve Bank credit to the centre.
